architecture_decisions.rationale: During collectstatic, URL substitutions were being applied to URLs found inside CSS/JS comments. This fix makes the static files storage skip URLs inside comments.

tickets.title: Ignore URLs inside comments during collectstatic
tickets.description: During collectstatic, URL substitutions were being applied to URLs found inside CSS/JS comments. This fix makes the static files storage skip URLs inside comments.

implementation_summary: This change implements 'Ignore URLs inside comments during collectstatic' for django. During collectstatic, URL substitutions were being applied to URLs found inside CSS/JS comments. This fix makes the static files storage skip URLs inside comments. Modified files: django/contrib/staticfiles/storage.py, docs/ref/contrib/staticfiles.txt, tests/staticfiles_tests/project/documents/cached/css/ignored.css, tests/staticfiles_tests/project/documents/cached/module.js, tests/staticfiles_tests/test_storage.py.
